findings.rationale: The theorem is organized around the canonical three-stage factorization of one function and separately identifies the direct composite. A commutative diagram would make the quotient, bijection onto the image, inclusion, and factorization relation immediately visible; the same map data recur in the existence and uniqueness clauses.
concrete_maps_and_relations: π : A → A/(ker f), a ↦ [a], surjective quotient map
f̄ : A/(ker f) → f[A], [a] ↦ f(a), bijection
ι : f[A] → B, y ↦ y, inclusion injection
Commutativity: ι ∘ f̄ ∘ π = f; uniqueness of f̄ is separately stated in clause (v).
